lines.zh: 林子里影子和蹄印一起走。
lines.en: In the woods, my hoofprints walk with shadows.
Dry leaves crumble to dust under my hooves.
There is a path beneath the cherry trees.
I walk slowly; my ears arrive first.
My hooves sink into soft moss.
I circle toward the smell of mochi.
A branch brushes my antler and springs back.
The mud by the stream is soft and easy.
I stop at every step to listen.
I keep to the light and shade, unseen.
The leaves are deep; I lift my legs.

lines.zh: 我走到林缘，就不再往前。
lines.en: I stop at the forest edge and go no farther.

lines.zh: 我在樱树下站着，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand under the cherry tree, perfectly still.
My ears turn once; nothing there.
I lower my head for a young shoot.
A petal is caught on my antler.
The wind lifts my tail.

lines.zh: 远处有蹄声，可能是同类。
lines.en: Hooves sound far off, maybe my kin.
I shake the dappled light off my back.

lines.zh: 麻糬的甜味还在鼻子里。
lines.en: The sweet smell of mochi lingers in my nose.
I do not dare sleep too deeply.
A bird lands on my antler.
I chew a clump of young grass for ages.

lines.zh: 林子里静得能听见汁液。
lines.en: The woods are quiet enough to hear sap.

lines.zh: 第七片叶子落在我的角上。
lines.en: The seventh leaf lands on my antler.

lines.zh: 我又看了一眼那条小路。
lines.en: I glance again at that little path.

lines.zh: 樱花麻糬的味道，我认得。
lines.en: I know the smell of cherry mochi.
Blossoms land on my back; I don't shake.
I listen to water far away.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷起一片嫩叶。
lines.en: I curl my tongue around a tender leaf.

lines.zh: 你站得这么静，像块石头。
lines.en: You stand so still, like a stone.

lines.zh: 你的手上有麻糬的甜味。
lines.en: Your hands smell sweet of mochi.
Your axe is bright, but I did not run.
Your shadow stretches longer than the trees.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼睛，你也在看。
lines.en: I look at your eyes; you look back.
You take one step; I take half back.

lines.zh: 你的味道很新，不像林子。
lines.en: Your scent is new, not of this forest.

lines.zh: 我听不懂，但你的语调很轻。
lines.en: I do not understand, but your voice is gentle.
Hand raised, are you offering me food?
A petal falls behind you.
Do not move suddenly; I startle easily.

lines.zh: 我们互相看了一会儿，够了。
lines.en: We look at each other a while; that is enough.
An axe bit my shoulder and I knelt.
That hurts; I leap away.
Half my antler is broken.
I dive into thick woods; you cannot follow.
That arrow will keep me down half a month.
There is still half a shoot in my mouth.
Blood soaks into the leaf litter, unseen.
I can still stand; stay back.
Whose arrow was that?
I will remember this tree.

lines.zh: 樱花麻糬，我闻到甜味了。
lines.en: Cherry blossom mochi, I smell the sweetness.

lines.zh: 那个粉色的东西，能给我吗？
lines.en: That pink thing, may I have it?

lines.zh: 我的鼻子往前探了一寸。
lines.en: My nose stretches forward an inch.
The sweetness makes me forget caution.
Mochi sticks to my teeth, but I like it.
Leave the mochi by the tree roots?
My nose is more honest than my eyes.
One more piece; I am not greedy.
Cherry blossom flavor, nothing else.

lines.zh: 我低头的速度比你想的快。
lines.en: I lower my head faster than you think.

lines.zh: 你的肩磕到角尖，出血了吗？
lines.en: Your shoulder met my antler tip; are you bleeding?

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，落叶都飞了。
lines.en: We collided and the leaves flew.
I step aside; the forest is wide.
Do not come from behind; I will bolt.
My hoof found your foot; sorry.
Your armor is heavy; I move aside.

lines.zh: 角卡在树枝里，等我一下。
lines.en: My antler is caught in a branch; wait.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，落叶被带起。
lines.en: We brushed past and the leaves lifted.
That bump nearly cost me the mochi.
You take the left; I take the right.
Half of my cherry mochi is yours.
Follow me; that path is quiet.
My antlers are decent, are they not?
Let us graze together at the forest edge.
If you walk slowly, I slow down too.

lines.zh: 冬天之前，得找个背风处。
lines.en: Before winter, we need a sheltered spot.
Do not worry; I do not kick my own.
We stand side by side watching cherry petals.
Your hoofprints run beside mine.

lines.zh: 这片林子够我们两个吃。
lines.en: This forest has enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 地上这块麻糬，我叼走了。
lines.en: I take this mochi from the ground.
I pick up a twig for the nest edge.
This bark will do for rubbing my antlers.
My mouth is full already.
Dropped it; I pick it up again.
I keep this flower.
I spotted that flower first.
I set the berries under the tree.
I leave what hangs on my antler.

lines.zh: 捡东西时我耳朵还竖着。
lines.en: Even picking things up, my ears stay up.
Something moves behind the bushes.
That smell is wrong; I raise my head.
A step snapped a dead branch.

lines.zh: 我盯住那片晃动的蕨叶。
lines.en: I fix on the swaying fern.
It is too close to my little path.
My antlers lower first.
Wolf or man? I need a clear look.
The wind shifted and the smell grew nearer.
I take half a step back and gather myself.
The moment it moves, I know.
I do not blink; neither should it.
My forehoof paws the ground, once, twice.
I judge its distance to the tree.
Antlers aimed; no turning back.
If it backs off, I press forward.
I watch its shoulder, not its eyes.
Breathing slows, hooves steady.
The leaves are loud; I freeze.

lines.zh: 它脚步偏左，想抄我后面。
lines.en: Its steps drift left, aiming behind me.
Once my hooves are set, I charge.
My antlers go up and it retreats.
My forehooves kick out and connect.
I shove it away; I do not mean to kill.
That impact made the trunk ring.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在我背上划开一道。
lines.en: Its claws opened a line across my back.
Head low, I butt again.
When it is over, I withdraw into the trees.
Its fur still hangs on my antler.
Do not push me; I do not want this.
My breathing is louder than my hooves.
I step out of the cherry tree's shade.
The cherry petals just fell, and I arrived.
Unfamiliar leaves under my hooves.
First water, then food.
This wind tastes of salt? Strange.
I shake the petals off my back.
My antlers are not grown; I keep low.
The forest tells me which way to go.
I opened my eyes to birdsong.
I will walk this ground once.
There is mochi nearby, not far.
I leave my hoofprints here.
My coat is scorched; I smell like charcoal.
I landed and my legs nearly buckled.
Water to my neck, I paddle hard.

lines.zh: 爆响过后，我耳朵里全是嗡。
lines.en: After the blast my ears are all ringing.

lines.zh: 箭杆插在后腿上，走不快。
lines.en: An arrow shaft in my hind leg slows me.
This light numbs my antlers.
The shoots are gone and my stomach complains.

lines.zh: 雷劈在近处，我耳朵聋了。
lines.en: Lightning struck close; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我四蹄空蹬。
lines.en: No earth beneath; my four hooves flail.
